# Sources: ICP for search

Read 2026-10-30. "Read" means the primary text was in hand. "Summary only" means only an abstract, a catalog record, search snippets or a third-party
summary was reached, and nothing from it is quoted as the author's words. Sources already listed in
`../personas/sources.md` are named here only when this folder relies on them.


## Founding segmentation

- Wind, Y. and Cardozo, R. (1974), "Industrial market segmentation", Industrial Marketing Management 3(3),
  153-165. Summary only (paywalled): https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Industrial_market_segmentation ,
  https://ana.esomar.org/documents/industrial-market-segmentation-
- Choffray, J.-M. and Lilien, G. L. (1980), "Industrial Market Segmentation by the Structure of the Purchasing
  Process", IMM 9(4), 331-342. Read in full (ORBi Liège open-access scan, handle 2268/175126, read as page
  images).
- Shapiro, B. P. and Bonoma, T. V. (1984), "How to Segment Industrial Markets", HBR, May 1984; Bonoma and Shapiro
  (1983), MSI working paper; Segmenting the Industrial Market, Lexington Books. Summary only (abstract and date):
  https://hbr.org/1984/05/how-to-segment-industrial-markets ,
  https://www.msi.org/working-papers/industrial-market-segmentation-a-nested-approach/ ,
  https://www.liquisearch.com/industrial_market_segmentation/nested_approach_to_segmentation_bonoma_amp_shapiro_model
- Mora Cortez, R., Højbjerg Clarke, A. and Freytag, P. V. (2021), "B2B market segmentation: A systematic review and
  research agenda", Journal of Business Research 126, 415-428. Read in full (accepted manuscript).
- Cabanelas, P., Mora Cortez, R. and Charterina, J. (2023), IMM 108, review of 89 articles. Read.
- Cardinali, S., Mero, J., Severini, A. and Terho, H. (2024, EMAC 53rd; IMM 133, 148-161, 2026). Read.
- Kuipers, University of Twente bachelor thesis (stopping rule quoting Wind and Cardozo). Read in full.

## Primaries never read

Wind and Cardozo 1974; Shapiro and Bonoma 1984 (HBR full text) and the 1983 MSI paper; Moore, Crossing the Chasm,
chapter 4; Ross and Tyler, the Predictable Revenue ICP chapter; Miller and Heiman, The New Strategic Selling;
Cooper 1999, the "User Persona, Not a Buyer Persona" section body; Christensen et al. 2016 full text; Moesta,
Demand-Side Sales 101; Revella 2015 book; Kennedy, Ehrenberg and Long 2000; Uncles et al. 2012 full text;
Anesbury et al. 2017; Kalafatis and Cheston 1997; Webster and Wind 1972 full text; the ITSMA 2017 "Role-Based
Profiles Are NOT Buyer Personas" post; the Gartner buying-journey pages (403); IMM 133 on how managers judge account
value (paywalled).
